comment: clock_hz 0 means stop the clock: a clock_hz event with value 0 at selection. Steps wait 0 (no wait, no time passes), wait 30, set 9. A set that is the last step is followed at once by the reset: set at 30, rst_n low at 30, high at 32. The steps restart at 32: wait 0 passes at once, the 30 ms wait ends at 62, set 9, reset 62..64; the next wait would end at 94, after until_ms 70. One project, so no next.
